title: Sprint 5 — System Administration & Security
description: Master system administration by managing storage, securing user access, hardening systems, and optimizing performance.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Storage & Disk Management
tickets.description:
Prepare storage devices by creating partitions and filesystems.
Implement flexible storage solutions using logical volumes.
Manage storage consumption by enforcing user and group quotas.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.1 — Partitioning & Filesystems
tasks.description: Initialize new storage drives, divide them into manageable partitions, apply filesystems, and ensure they are accessible upon reboot.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.2 — LVM (Logical Volume Management)
tasks.description: Configure advanced storage pools, allocate flexible volumes, and expand storage capacity seamlessly without interrupting services.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.3 — Disk Quotas
tasks.description: Establish storage limits for system users, defining both warning thresholds and strict boundaries to prevent disk exhaustion.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — User Administration & sudo
tickets.description:
Administer system users and groups with specific attributes.
Provide controlled administrative access without sharing passwords.
Enhance authentication security with robust modular policies.

tasks.title: Task 5.2.1 — User & Group Management
tasks.description: Create system accounts with precise identifiers, organize them into appropriate groups, and enforce strict password policies.

tasks.title: Task 5.2.2 — sudo Configuration
tasks.description: Configure administrative privileges to allow specific users to execute essential commands securely while restricting broad access.

tasks.title: Task 5.2.3 — PAM Configuration
tasks.description: Implement advanced authentication rules to mandate password complexity, restrict repeated failures, and enhance overall login security.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — System Security & Hardening
tickets.description:
Secure remote access configurations against common vulnerabilities.
Enforce mandatory access controls to limit application behaviors.
Establish comprehensive logging to audit system activity and compliance.

tasks.title: Task 5.3.1 — SSH Hardening
tasks.description: Strengthen remote access by restricting administrative logins, requiring cryptographic keys, and implementing connection rate limits.

tasks.title: Task 5.3.2 — SELinux / AppArmor
tasks.description: Enable strict access control policies, troubleshoot permission denials, and create custom security profiles for specific applications.

tasks.title: Task 5.3.3 — Audit & Compliance
tasks.description: Configure the system to record critical security events, track sensitive file access, and analyze the resulting audit trails.

tickets.title: Ticket 4 — Performance Monitoring & Tuning
tickets.description:
Identify performance bottlenecks across various system resources.
Optimize system behavior by adjusting kernel parameters.
Isolate applications and restrict their resource consumption.

tasks.title: Task 5.4.1 — System Monitoring
tasks.description: Establish performance baselines and utilize diagnostic tools to pinpoint whether issues stem from processing, memory, or storage constraints.

tasks.title: Task 5.4.2 — Kernel Tuning with sysctl
tasks.description: Modify core system parameters to optimize behavior under high loads and ensure these optimizations persist across restarts.

tasks.title: Task 5.4.3 — cgroups & Resource Limits
tasks.description: Implement strict resource boundaries to limit the maximum processing power and memory that specific applications can consume.
